description: Table of contents of a German federal law or ordinance (Bücher/Abschnitte/Titel/Kapitel) with the §/Art. provisions listed under each heading, from Gesetze im Internet. `depth` controls how many heading levels come back; pass a `section_id` from a previous answer to expand one branch. A branch with more provisions than `provision_limit` says so (`has_more_provisions`) rather than truncating silently. Use to browse a law's structure or list the provisions of one chapter.

depth.description: Heading levels to return below the starting point, 1-8 (default 2).

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.

provision_limit.description: Max provisions listed per heading before has_more_provisions, 10-400 (default 100).

section_id.description: Optional structural-heading id (Gliederungskennzahl) from a previous gesetze_structure answer, to expand one branch.

name: gesetze_structure
title: Gesetze Structure
